analysis.summaryJa: whether節はAかnot A、またはAかBという二択全体を名詞の席に置く。特に文頭主語やwhether or notではwhetherが安定する。wh節は直接疑問の疑問語を残しつつ、内部をwh＋主語＋動詞の平叙文語順に戻し、主語・目的語・前置詞の目的語として使う。
grammarPoints: whether＋節は〜かどうかという二択を名詞化する
文頭主語の正式な名詞節ではifではなくwhetherを用いる
whether A or Bで二つの選択肢を明示できる
wh名詞節の内部は主語＋動詞の通常語順にする
埋込みwh節ではdo支えや助動詞倒置を行わない
visualEvidence: WHETHERの天秤にAとnot Aが載る
文頭ではifを使わないという緑の注意書きがある
直接疑問Where did Ken go?が機械を通りwhere Ken wentへ変わる
wh＋subject＋verbの通常語順がブロックで示される
commonTraps: 文頭主語のwhether節をifで始める
wh節内部に直接疑問のdo・does・didを残す
埋込み節でも助動詞を主語の前に置く
whether節の後ろに不要なthatを加える

questions.prompt: ------- the flight departs on time is uncertain.

choices.D: That whether

questions.translationJa: その便が定刻に出発するかどうかは不確かです。
questions.explanationJa: 文頭で二択の名詞節を主語にするためWhetherを使います。

questions.prompt: The committee will decide ------- to renew the maintenance contract.

choices.D: what did

questions.translationJa: 委員会は保守契約を更新するかどうか決定します。
questions.explanationJa: decideの目的語として二択を表すwhether節を置きます。

questions.prompt: Please tell me where the visitor -------.

questions.focus: 助動詞を倒置しないwh節

questions.prompt: Choose the correct formal subject clause.

choices.D: Whether the office will relocate is unknown.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct embedded question.

choices.B: Could you tell me where the conference room is?

choices.D: Could you tell me where the conference room does?

choices.B: Whether do we meet Monday or Tuesday depends on the director.
choices.C: Whether we meet Monday or Tuesday depends on the director.
choices.D: Whether we meet Monday or Tuesday it depends on the director.

questions.explanationJa: Whether A or B全体を主語にし、倒置も余分なitも置きません。

choices.B: I remember how did the technician solve the problem.

choices.B: The issue whether the warranty covers is labor.
choices.C: The issue is that whether the warranty covers labor.
choices.D: The issue is whether the warranty covers labor.

questions.explanationJa: be動詞の後ろにwhether＋主語＋動詞の名詞節を置きます。

choices.B: No one knows where the courier did went.
choices.C: No one knows where the courier went.
choices.D: No one knows did the courier go where.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence with “whether or not.”

choices.A: We must decide if or not the event will proceed.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct embedded question about price.

choices.A: The buyer asked how much did the extended warranty cost.
choices.B: The buyer asked how much the extended warranty did costed.
choices.C: The buyer asked did the extended warranty cost how much.
choices.D: The buyer asked how much the extended warranty cost.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence with a wh-clause subject.

choices.A: Why was the package returned remains unclear.

choices.C: Why the package was returned remains unclear.

questions.translationJa: なぜ荷物が返品されたかは不明のままです。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence after a preposition.

choices.B: Our decision depends on how soon is the permit issued.
choices.C: Our decision depends how soon the permit is issued on.
choices.D: Our decision depends on does the permit issue how soon.

questions.translationJa: 当社の決定は許可がどれほど早く発行されるか次第です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “Whether the store will reopen is uncertain.”

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “Tell me where the keys are.”

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “Whether we stay or leave depends on the weather.”

choices.D: Our choice will not be affected by weather.

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “I wonder when the refund will appear.”

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The question is whether both plans are affordable.”
